g.text: The adjusted comparison is only as good as these three things

g.text: Check that slopes are (roughly) parallel, that the groups overlap on the covariate, and that the covariate isn't caused by the treatment.

g.text: If slopes differ, report the group difference at several covariate values instead of one 'adjusted effect'.
